    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Loosen the {{ing_01|meat}} from the bones by means of a wooden stick in order to fill the cavity left by the bones with dressing which is introduced through a funnel."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "The dressing season with {{ing_02|crushed pepper}}, {{ing_03|laurel berries}} and {{ing_04|rue}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "If you like, add {{ing_05|laser}}, the {{ing_06|best kind of broth}}, {{ing_07|reduced must}} and sprinkle with {{ing_08|fresh oil}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "When the filling is done, tie the parts thus stuffed in {{ing_09|linen}}, place them in the stock pot in which they are to be cooked and boil them in {{ing_10|sea water}}, with a {{ing_11|sprig of laurel}} and {{ing_12|dill}}."
